name: Accelerant Holdings
description: Accelerant Holdings operates as a data-driven risk exchange that connects selected specialty insurance underwriters with risk capital partners. The company operates in three segments: Exchange Services, MGA Operations, and Underwriting. The majority of its revenue is generated from the Underwriting segment, which contains all revenue and expenses associated with the underwriting of insurance policies and assumption of reinsurance policies issued or accepted by Accelerant's consolidated insurance and reinsurance companies. Geographically, it operates in North America, the UK, and the EU, out of which it derives maximum revenue from North America.
